clips.title: The story
paras: With the ogres' defenses weakened, Melisara in Tarren Mill wants the heads of Mug'Thol's three lieutenants, Targ, Muckrake and Glommus, before Mug'Thol himself is dealt with.

Mug'Thol's lieutenants are Targ, Muckrake and Glommus, all loyal to him, though Melisara wonders what could make an ogre loyal. You are to kill all three and bring their heads back to Tarren Mill. After that, only Mug'Thol's own head remains to be taken, crown and all.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Targ, Muckrake, and Glommus are Mug'Thol's lieutenants. They are loyal to him, though who can say what drives an ogre to loyalty.
Bring me their heads, friend, and then all that will remain is to remove Mug'Thol's head, crown and all.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I want their heads, friend, not excuses.

clips.title: Completion
paras: ...and I thought ogres smelled foul enough to begin with.
When you bring me Mug'Thol's head, I will have the four of them mounted on pikes above Alterac. A fitting monument to those who go against the Dark Lady's wishes.
